tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat a portal account, docket caption, landlord ledger, or voucher record as the person/unit map; reconcile identities first.
tests.label: Household, unit, landlord, and authority split
tests.question: Can the packet identify the household, unit, lease / occupancy, subsidy, landlord / property manager, plaintiff, payment recipient, authorized helper, language, disability, and safety constraints before assigning housing status?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not infer physical eviction from filing alone or safety from a closed docket alone; build the possession timeline.
tests.label: Notice, service, and possession clock
tests.question: Does the record show rent demand or pay-or-quit notice, service method, summons, hearing, default, judgment, warrant, lockout / execution, move-out, and appeal clock as separate states?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not count assistance as stability until it changes the ledger and possession clock.
tests.label: Rental-assistance posting and court effect
tests.question: Can assistance be traced from application through eligibility, award, landlord acceptance, payment, ledger posting, stay / dismissal effect, residual balance, court costs, and future-rent bridge?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat a right-to-counsel law or referral as counsel at the consequential event.
tests.label: Representation capacity and hearing posture
tests.question: Does the packet distinguish outreach, intake, eligibility, advice, brief service, full representation, adjournment, settlement quality, hearing coverage, and provider capacity?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not call a case resolved until downstream tenant-screening records and adverse-action routes are bounded.
tests.label: Tenant-screening record and adverse action
tests.question: Can eviction, criminal, credit, and court-record entries in tenant-screening reports be traced to source, disposition, age, sealed / dismissed status, adverse action, consumer disclosure, dispute, correction, and reapplication effect?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat a referral, bed count, or PIT statistic as a safe relocation outcome.
tests.label: Shelter, relocation, and re-housing bridge
tests.question: If tenancy is not preserved, does the record show shelter / motel / rapid-rehousing placement, transport, storage, school / work continuity, disability accommodation, safety, pets, and permanent-housing search?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not rely only on court records where informal or constructive displacement is plausible.
tests.label: Informal eviction and extra-legal pressure
tests.question: Does the packet look for lockout, utility shutoff pressure, harassment, constructive eviction, uninhabitable conditions, retaliation, illegal fees, or move-out under threat that may not appear as a clean court outcome?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not close the continuity packet at dismissal, payment, or move-out if durable exclusion remains.
tests.label: Tail risk: debt, sealing, credit, and recurrence
tests.question: Does the record preserve debt, judgment, collections, court costs, sealing / expungement, screening correction, reapplication, repeat filings, next rent, and subsidy / renewal clocks after the immediate case closes?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not call a program equitable from citywide or statewide averages alone.
tests.label: Equity denominators and landlord concentration
tests.question: Can filing, default, judgment, warrant, execution, assistance, representation, screening, shelter, and repeat-filing outcomes be disaggregated by race, income, disability, language, family status, neighborhood, property type, subsidy status, and landlord concentration?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not generalize a local portal, expired federal program, or monitored-sites dataset into a national operational rule.
tests.label: Source-currentness and local-law boundary
pass_evidence: local court rule or official page
tests.question: Does the packet distinguish live dashboards, annual reports, local court rules, expired federal assistance authority, local program windows, enforcement actions, and research reports before generalizing?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat eviction filing counts, portal states, counsel eligibility, payment awards, screening pages, or shelter counts as household stability proof until outcome and non-user denominators are explicit.
tests.label: Household outcome and non-user denominator
pass_evidence: sample frame includes households with filings, dismissed cases, defaults, lockouts, informal move-outs, shelter entry, re-housing, and no portal/counsel contact
burden and access limits are measured for language, disability, safety, digital access, documentation, work schedule, caregiving, and transport constraints
filing, payment, counsel, screening, and shelter denominators are reconciled with known missing populations and limitations
tests.question: Does the packet distinguish filing, portal, counsel, payment, screening, and shelter surfaces from household outcome, informal eviction, non-use, and subgroup burden evidence?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not score assistance approval, payment issuance, legal eligibility, report correction, or shelter referral as repair until durable household consequence is evidenced.
tests.label: Housing remedy-completion and durable-stability receipt
pass_evidence: rental-assistance payment is tied to the right ledger, landlord/payment recipient, court case, residual balance, and future-rent bridge
counsel or assistance is followed through adjournment, settlement, dismissal, possession protection, safe relocation, or appeal/sealing result
screening correction, adverse-action notice, reapplication effect, shelter/re-housing path, recurrence, and stability at follow-up are recorded
tests.question: Can the packet prove that a housing remedy changed possession, debt, screening, shelter, or durable housing status rather than merely being offered, awarded, or logged?

use_rule: Run housing-continuity tests whenever rental assistance, eviction notices, court filings, possession clocks, right-to-counsel routes, tenant-screening reports, shelter referrals, relocation, voucher / subsidy cliffs, landlord ledgers, or informal displacement can determine whether a household is actually stably housed. Separate household, unit, arrears, assistance, court, possession, representation, screening, shelter, and tail-risk states before treating a portal, docket, report, or referral as housing stability.
